diff --git a/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py b/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
index 9ce46e3f73..61b21d4dad 100644
--- a/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
+++ b/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
@@ -280,6 +280,20 @@ class Field(RegisterLookupMixin):
             if isinstance(choices_group, str):
                 break
         else:
+            # Everything is OK so far, check max_length fits the longest choice.
+            if self.max_length is not None:
+                choices = self.flatchoices
+                if choices:
+                    longest = max(len(value) for value, _ in choices)
+                    if longest > self.max_length:
+                        return [
+                            checks.Error(
+                                "'max_length' is too small to fit the longest "
+                                "value in 'choices' (%d characters)." % longest,
+                                obj=self,
+                                id='fields.E009',
+                            )
+                        ]
             return []
 
         return [

diff --git a/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py b/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
index 9ce46e3f73..02eca5f0fb 100644
--- a/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
+++ b/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
@@ -280,6 +280,37 @@ class Field(RegisterLookupMixin):
             if isinstance(choices_group, str):
                 break
         else:
+            # If we didn't break, check max_length is large enough for
+            # the longest choice.
+            if self.max_length is not None:
+                choices = []
+                for group in self.choices:
+                    if isinstance(group, (list, tuple)):
+                        # Check if this is a group: [group_name, [value, display]]
+                        if (
+                            len(group) == 2 and
+                            isinstance(group[1], (list, tuple)) and
+                            group[1] and
+                            isinstance(group[1][0], (list, tuple))
+                        ):
+                            choices.extend(group[1])
+                        else:
+                            choices.append(group)
+                    else:
+                        choices.append(group)
+                longest = max(
+                    (len(value) for value, _ in choices if isinstance(value, str)),
+                    default=0,
+                )
+                if longest > self.max_length:
+                    return [
+                        checks.Error(
+                            "'max_length' is too small to fit the longest value "
+                            "in 'choices' (%d characters)." % longest,
+                            obj=self,
+                            id='fields.E009',
+                        )
+                    ]
             return []
 
         return [

diff --git a/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py b/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
index 9ce46e3f73..8e2005a2da 100644
--- a/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
+++ b/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
@@ -280,6 +280,32 @@ class Field(RegisterLookupMixin):
             if isinstance(choices_group, str):
                 break
         else:
+            # If we got here, choices is a well-formed iterable of pairs.
+            # Check that max_length is large enough to fit the longest choice.
+            if self.max_length is not None:
+                # Flatten grouped choices to get all values.
+                choices_values = []
+                for choice in self.choices:
+                    if isinstance(choice, (list, tuple)):
+                        # Grouped choices: [group_name, [value, display], ...]
+                        for value, _ in choice[1]:
+                            choices_values.append(value)
+                    else:
+                        # Single choice: (value, display)
+                        choices_values.append(choice[0])
+                # Check string values only.
+                str_values = [v for v in choices_values if isinstance(v, str)]
+                if str_values:
+                    longest = max(len(v) for v in str_values)
+                    if longest > self.max_length:
+                        return [
+                            checks.Error(
+                                "'max_length' is too small to fit the longest "
+                                "value in 'choices' (%d characters)." % longest,
+                                obj=self,
+                                id='fields.E009',
+                            )
+                        ]
             return []
 
         return [
